notes.title: Windows 8 /8.1 - Updated link for the fix
notes.notes:

Please use Microsoft's official link here in order to install the Direct X runtime which will allow Gray Matter to run.

Thank You ,

Community Support at Encore Software.

notes.title: Announcement on Windows 8 / 8.1 installation issues for Gray Matter
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

It has come to our attention that during the QA process on Windows 8 / 8.1 for Gray Matter on Steam, the installer was not installing all of the components needed for this game to function correctly. Please see the link below and manually install the Direct X runtime. Once installed, your game should function on Windows 8 / 8.1 normally.

http://s3.encore.com/Development/directx9.zip

If you have any further compatibility issues or require further troubleshooting, please submit a trouble ticket at the following link :

http://support.encore.com/technicalsupport/tech_support_frm.aspx?product_id=3160

After a tragic accident, neurobiologist Dr. David Styles has become a recluse, rarely leaving his home, the Dread Hill House. One day, Samantha Everett, a street magician, appears at Dr. Style's doorstep just as he is seeking a new assistant.
